title: Seaview Hideaway House | KEY.co
description_expanded: After a day of adventures, retreat to the private balcony and be mesmerized by the enchanting ocean view. Alternatively, take a dip in the glittering pool to relax your muscles or hop on the provided bikes for a scenic ride along the coast. With private beach access, the sand and surf are just moments away, offering endless opportunities for fun and relaxation. For those who love to cook, the stylish kitchen is a dream come true. Complete with stainless steel appliances, a floating island breakfast bar, and a formal dining table, it provides the ideal setting for preparing grand meals and beach picnic snacks. If you need to catch up on work, a dedicated workspace with a desk and chair is available for remote work. Escape to the breathtaking beauty of Santa Rosa Beach, the jewel of the Florida Panhandle. This enchanting vacation home offers everything you need for an unforgettable coastal retreat. With its four bedrooms and three bathrooms, it can comfortably accommodate up to 14 guests, making it perfect for large families or groups of friends.

Features: Outdoor Pool Heated pool Outdoor grill
Parking information- There is free parking for vehicles.
Use of charcoal grills is not allowed.
